certification.mechanic: Items have a Rarity rating normally from 0 to 5. For an Availability roll, roll a number of CD equal to LCK; the number of Effects rolled is the maximum Rarity available.
certification.localizationNote: The official FR page prints CHA for the Availability roll. Canonical EN uses LCK, so LCK is the certified mechanic.

entries.justification: General opposed-test transaction procedure, not a standalone reusable compendium document.

certification.mechanic: Make an opposed CHA + Barter test. Success improves the price by 10%; success plus 2 AP improves it by 20%. Failure leaves the price unchanged unless the opponent spends 2 AP, which makes it 10% less favorable.

entries.justification: Transaction example/sidebar guidance, not a standalone reusable compendium document.

certification.mechanic: Aggregate all items bought or sold to one trader and make one haggling roll for the whole transaction.

entries.justification: General transaction procedure, not a standalone reusable compendium document.

certification.mechanic: When buying and selling in the same transaction, subtract the lower total value from the higher, then optionally haggle the final price.

certification.mechanic: Above Carry Weight: STR/AGI test difficulty +1, no Sprint, Initiative -1. Each additional 50 lbs. above Carry Weight increases those penalties by 1. At twice Carry Weight: cannot move, automatically fail STR/AGI tests, Initiative 0.
certification.localizationNote: Official FR converts each 50 lb. increment to 25 kg, consistent with the project conversion convention.

certification.installRule: Difficulty 1 INT + the skill listed in the mod description; one hour. Spend 2 AP on success to halve the time. On failure, roll 1 CD; an Effect damages the mod and it cannot be used.
certification.localizationNote: The official FR page uses “mod de fonctionnalité” for the second armor mod category; the canonical EN + Errata category is unique mod.
